title: ITIL 4 Managing Professional - ITIL 4 Specialist: High-Velocity IT (HVIT)
overview: The HVIT course covers the use of IT in rapidly changing, high-velocity environments. It introduces Agile, Lean, and DevOps practices, with a focus on delivering IT services quickly and effectively to meet business demands in the digital age.
audience: IT managers and leaders in digital transformation
IT consultants involved in digital services
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Key insights into high-velocity IT operations.
Hands-On Labs: Practical applications of Agile and DevOps practices.
Case Studies: Real-world digital transformation examples.
Assessments: Quizzes and mock exams for certification preparation.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Learn to manage and optimize IT services in high-velocity digital environments.
Understand Agile, Lean, and DevOps principles and practices.
Develop the ability to quickly deliver and support digital services.
Prepare for the ITIL HVIT certification exam.

items.text: Role of IT in Digital Transformation
Lean IT Principles and Waste Elimination
Automating IT Operations for Speed and Efficiency
Ensuring Resilience and Stability Amid Change
